title: Data Analytics - Data Science Trainer
job_description: About Vertical Institute Vertical Institute is a leading Singapore-based AI training provider focused on equipping working professionals with in-demand, career-advancing skills. We focus on artificial intelligence and other emerging, high-impact technologies, with a strong emphasis on real-world application over theory. We are a Registered Training Provider (RTP) with SkillsFuture Singapore, and have trained tens of thousands of professionals across both individual and corporate programmes, including partnerships with government agencies and enterprises. Our mission is to help individuals and organisations stay relevant and competitive in an AI-driven economy. We design and deliver practical, hands-on courses that equip professionals with immediately applicable skills that drive real outcomes at work. We are a fast-growing organisation that values ownership, speed, and continuous improvement. If you are excited about shaping how AI transforms work and education, you will find strong alignment here. Role Overview Vertical Institute is seeking an experienced Data Analytics & Data Science Trainer to deliver engaging, industry-relevant training programmes for adult learners and professionals. The trainer will conduct courses in areas such as: Advanced Data Science Data Analytics using Power BI Mastering Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Carbon Reporting & Greenhouse Gas Measurement Key Responsibilities Deliver instructor-led training to adult learners in classroom or online settings Facilitate practical, hands-on learning using real-world datasets and case studies Adapt training delivery to suit learners with varying levels of technical proficiency Support learners in completing exercises, projects, and assessments Ensure training delivery meets SSG/WSQ standards and adult learning best practices Work with the curriculum team to provide feedback for course improvement Requirements ACTA / ACLP certification (or equivalent adult education certification) Strong industry experience in data analytics, data science, or business intelligence Proficiency in tools such as: Power BI Python / R SQL Google Analytics Prior experience delivering corporate or professional training preferred Strong communication and facilitation skill Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for adult learners Preferred Experience Experience delivering SkillsFuture-funded training Experience working with mid-career professionals Prior teaching or lecturing experience Engagement Arrangement Trainers may be engaged on a contract or adjunct basis and may deliver one or multiple courses depending on their expertise and availability.
